chapterInfo.content:
49
Abɔnefoɔ ahotɔ nkyɛ
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfoɔ. Kora mma dwom.
1 # Dwom 37; 73 Aman nyinaa, montie yei,
mo a mote wiase nyinaa, monyɛ aso.
2Nnipa mma mpapahwekwaa oo,
mmarima mma a wɔwɔ din oo,
adefoɔ ne ahiafoɔ nyinaa.
3M’ano bɛka anyansasɛm,
na m’akomam nsusuiɛ yɛ nhunumu ara nko.
4 # Dwom 78.2 Mɛbrɛ m’aso ase matie abebusɛm,
mede sankubɔ mɛkyerɛ me bɛ ase.
5Adɛn nti na mensuro nna bɔne mu,
nna a m’atɛfoɔ amumuyɛ twa me ho hyia mu?
6Wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ahonyadeɛ so,
na wɔde wɔn adedodoɔ hoahoa wɔn ho.
7Onua rentumi nnye onipa da,
ɔremma Onyankopɔn ne mpatadeɛ,
8 # Mat 16.26 na wɔn kra gyeɛ boɔ yɛ den,
na ɛma no gya hɔ koraa,
9sɛ ɔntena ase ara daa,
na wanhunu Adamena.
10 # Ɔsɛ 2.16; 6.2 Na ɔhunu sɛ anyansafoɔ wuwu,
na saa nso na nkwasea ne agyimifoɔ sɛeɛ,
na wɔgya wɔn ahodeɛ ma ebinom.
11Wɔn tirim ne sɛ wɔn adan bɛtena hɔ daa,
na wɔn afie atena hɔ akɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so;
wɔde wɔn din toto wɔn nsase.
12 # Ɔsɛ 3.19; 2 Pe 2.12 Nanso onipa a ɔwɔ anidie mu no, ɔrentena mu,
ɔte sɛ mmoa a wɔyi wɔn hɔ.
13Ɔkwan a nkwasea fa soɔ nie,
na wɔn a wɔpɛ wɔn anomu asɛm no di wɔn akyi.
14Wɔboa Asamando sɛ nnwan;
Owuo hwɛ wɔn so,
na teneneefoɔ bɛtiatia wɔn so anɔpa,
na wɔn deɛ, Asamando bɛsɛe wɔn ahoɔfɛ,
na wɔannya tenabea bio.
15 # Hos 13.14 Na me kra deɛ, Onyankopɔn bɛgye no Asamando nsam,
na ɔbɛgye me.
16 # Hiob 21.7-15 Sɛ obi nya ne ho a, nsuro,
sɛ ne fie animuonyam redɔɔso a, nsuro,
17 # Ɔsɛ 5.14-15 na ɔwu a, ɔremfa emu biribiara nkɔ,
n’animuonyam rensiane nni n’akyi.
18 # Luka 16.19-31 Sɛ ɔhyira ne kra ne nkwa berɛ mu,
nso wɔyi wo ayɛ sɛ woyɛ wo ho yie a,
19ɔbɛkɔ n’agyanom abusua mu,
wɔrenhunu hann ara da.
20 # Dwom 49.12 Onipa a ɔwɔ anidie mu na ɔnni nhunumu no,
ɔte sɛ mmoa a wɔyi wɔn hɔ.

Aman nyinaa, montie yei,
mo a mote wiase nyinaa, monyɛ aso.
Nnipa mma mpapahwekwaa oo,
mmarima mma a wɔwɔ din oo,
adefoɔ ne ahiafoɔ nyinaa.
M’ano bɛka anyansasɛm,
na m’akomam nsusuiɛ yɛ nhunumu ara nko.
Mɛbrɛ m’aso ase matie abebusɛm,
mede sankubɔ mɛkyerɛ me bɛ ase.
Adɛn nti na mensuro nna bɔne mu,
nna a m’atɛfoɔ amumuyɛ twa me ho hyia mu?
Wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ahonyadeɛ so,
na wɔde wɔn adedodoɔ hoahoa wɔn ho.
Onua rentumi nnye onipa da,
ɔremma Onyankopɔn ne mpatadeɛ,
na wɔn kra gyeɛ boɔ yɛ den,
na ɛma no gya hɔ koraa,
sɛ ɔntena ase ara daa,
na wanhunu Adamena.
Na ɔhunu sɛ anyansafoɔ wuwu,
na saa nso na nkwasea ne agyimifoɔ sɛeɛ,
na wɔgya wɔn ahodeɛ ma ebinom.
Wɔn tirim ne sɛ wɔn adan bɛtena hɔ daa,
na wɔn afie atena hɔ akɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so;
wɔde wɔn din toto wɔn nsase.
Nanso onipa a ɔwɔ anidie mu no, ɔrentena mu,
ɔte sɛ mmoa a wɔyi wɔn hɔ.
Ɔkwan a nkwasea fa soɔ nie,
na wɔn a wɔpɛ wɔn anomu asɛm no di wɔn akyi.
Wɔboa Asamando sɛ nnwan;
Owuo hwɛ wɔn so,
na teneneefoɔ bɛtiatia wɔn so anɔpa,
na wɔn deɛ, Asamando bɛsɛe wɔn ahoɔfɛ,
na wɔannya tenabea bio.
Na me kra deɛ, Onyankopɔn bɛgye no Asamando nsam,
na ɔbɛgye me.
Sɛ obi nya ne ho a, nsuro,
sɛ ne fie animuonyam redɔɔso a, nsuro,
na ɔwu a, ɔremfa emu biribiara nkɔ,
n’animuonyam rensiane nni n’akyi.
Sɛ ɔhyira ne kra ne nkwa berɛ mu,
nso wɔyi wo ayɛ sɛ woyɛ wo ho yie a,
ɔbɛkɔ n’agyanom abusua mu,
wɔrenhunu hann ara da.
Onipa a ɔwɔ anidie mu na ɔnni nhunumu no,
ɔte sɛ mmoa a wɔyi wɔn hɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
